spans.text: Commander, we have reached the target location.
I have sent you the enemies' information and coordinates.
We just encountered and neutralized a small detachment of Hydras.
However, we may have alerted the enemy to our presence.
Judging by the fireworks going on in the distance, the situation on board the train must be extremely dire. We need to reach the train as soon as possible.
Please guide us on our way.
